turns.question: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, how much higher in EUR was the average non-cancelled order amount of customers who signed up before 2026 than that of customers who signed up in 2026?
turns.answer: Customers who signed up before 2026 averaged 102.67 EUR per non-cancelled order against 41.00 EUR for customers who signed up in 2026, so the pre-2026 figure is 61.67 EUR higher, for orders placed 17 August to 10 October 2026.
